tools.name: report_rows
tools.description: Report two rows of test data as text and as a structured result. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: link_resources
tools.description: Return a resource link and an embedded text resource. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: rows.get
tools.description: Get one test row by id (1 or 2). The dot in this tool's name is deliberate.

tools.name: always_fails
tools.description: A tool that always reports an error result (isError). Takes no arguments.

tools.name: show_chart
tools.description: Show a chart of the test rows. Its UI is an MCP App. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: review_rows
tools.description: Show the test rows for review. Its UI is an MCP App that calls tools of its own. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: app_delete_row
tools.description: Delete one test row by id (1 or 2). For the review app only.

tools.name: model_only_note
tools.description: Return a note for the model only. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: model_only_chart
tools.description: Show the chart, for the model only. Takes no arguments.
